newsitem.title: UK: Hanson sees div policy prudent at first.
newsitem.headline: Hanson sees div policy prudent at first.

text.p: International building products and services group Hanson Plc said on Tuesday that its dividend policy would be prudent, but progressive over time.
It said in a statement that it expects dividend payments for the year ended December 31, 1997 will total 1.5p per share.
This payment represents 12p net per consolidated share. Hanson plans to consolidate its shares on the basis of one new Hanson share for eight existing shares.
"Dividend policy will be prudent, but progressive over time, recognising the need to invest for expansion and long term cash flow," said the company.
Hanson plans to make one interim and one final dividend payment instead of quarterly payments.
It said that following the demerger of its division The Energy Group Plc it would change its financial year-end to December 31 from September 30.
